text:
mike.ops: FYI — vendor_carol pinged about a partial DOA on the latest top-off. 12 H100s allocated to our EU pool, 2 failed POST at depot. AWBs: 9876543210, 9876543211. Need routing + RMA plan, this hits Dedicated capacity next week.
vendor_carol: Sorry about that, we're opening RMA tickets with the forwarder. Depot pics and failure logs attached to the RMA. We can offer 2 hot-swap replacements from our SG pool, ETA 48-72h after customs clears.
ananya.procure: Can we prioritize air uplift for the replacements? EU demand is saturated and we have two customer canaries on that pool. Cost delta ok if < $7k per unit.
jordan-sre: If those 2 units are out, autoscaler will throttle a few low-priority jobs. Can we schedule replacements before Monday morning SLO window?
vendor_carol: We can do air, but customs at FRA is holding AWB 9876543210 for inspection. Forwarder says missing CN22 on one crate. Working paperwork now. Air uplift would need a reissue, adds ~6h.
mike.ops: @vendor_carol please push photos of CN22 and the inspect form into the RMA thread. Also share the replacement serials so we can pre-seed inventory and update pool tags.
lee-logs: Quick check: these serials are currently tagged eu-dedicated-1 in inventory; if replacements come from SG we'll label eu-temp and route through AMS crossdock. Make sure to update node tags before onboarding.
ananya.procure: Agree with air if we can keep cost under threshold. Approving up to $6.5k per unit emergency uplift — escalate to finance if higher. Who owns the customs paperwork?
vendor_carol: We own HS code & CN documentation, but forwarder requested an importer declaration from us. Sharing a signed PDF now.
ops-bot: Deploy note: cluster eu-dedicated-1 will see -2 available GPUs from 2023-11-03T22:00Z until replacement attach.
jordan-sre: Plan B if air reissue fails: open partial AWB split and re-route via NL crossdock, target ETA +48h (slower but lower cost). Also propose soft-fallback: route some low-priority traffic to us-west overflow pool to avoid SLO alerts.
mike.ops: Okay — immediate actions: 1) @vendor_carol confirm reissue ETA (hrs), share replacement S/Ns; 2) @lee-logs prep eu-temp tagging and onboarding checklist; 3) @ananya.procure approve uplift or sign-off for crossdock. I'll notify CS about potential perf hit.
ananya.procure: If vendor covers customs rework fees we go air. If vendor asks us to cover > $2k, crossdock.
vendor_carol: Understood. We will cover paperwork and reissue fees; forwarder surcharge for air uplift is quoted at $5.2k/unit. We can split to 50% if needed — propose 50/50.
mike.ops: 50/50 is fine temporarily but get the split in writing. Also need written SLA for replacements (max 72h).
vendor_carol: Adding to the RMA ticket now, will attach replacement S/Ns and ETA + tracking once reissue completed.
lee-logs: When you have the S/Ns, share here in this format so infra can pre-stage:
```
replace_serials: [H100-AX12345, H100-AX12346]
awbs: [9876543210-reissued]
route: ams-crossdock -> eu-dedicated-1
```
mike.ops: Thanks — last ask: if replacements are refurbished, we need burn-in window of 8 hours before they join the pool. Tag them as pending-burnin.
jordan-sre: I'll add a short canary job to verify perf once they attach. If throughput drops >10% we'll failover more traffic.
ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2023-0457. Link: https://rma.vendor/2023/0457 (vendor_carol attached docs).
vendor_carol: RMA-2023-0457 updated — reissue submitted, provisional ETA 36h, replacements coming from SG depot. Will update if customs clears earlier.
ananya.procure: Noted. I'll loop in finance if vendor insists on >$2k split.
mike.ops: Great work. Keep thread updated, flag me directly if ETA slides beyond 48h. :thumbsup:
